//: markdownlint config for this repository's Markdown.
MD013 (line length): disabled because GitHub renders wide comparison
and tech-stack tables, and wrapping them destroys the columns. Tables
are the format the README uses for structured facts on purpose, so
that AI tools can parse them.
MD033 (inline HTML): disabled only because the screenshot row uses a
<table> to place four phone screenshots side by side. Markdown tables
cannot do that. All other Markdown stays HTML-free.
